items.headline: Four Naga civilians shot dead in Ukhrul
items.text: Suspected militants fired on two vehicles near New Haven on the Imphal–Ukhrul road, killing four Tangkhul Naga civilians, two of them women. Police say the attackers are unidentified and are investigating.

photo.alt: A hillside town of houses among green trees, with mountains and clouds behind.
photo.caption: Ukhrul town, Manipur, in the hills next to Kamjong district.

items.headline: Homes of 132 families demolished in Lakhimpur
items.text: Authorities demolished homes of 132 mostly Bengali Muslim families, displaced by 1983 riots, on grazing-reserve land at Boginadi. Residents allege selective targeting; the district commissioner says no illegal construction on such land will be tolerated.

photo.alt: Green fields and tall trees beyond a small stream crossed by a bamboo footbridge, with a milestone in the foreground.
photo.caption: Village fields in Lakhimpur district, Assam, in 2019. File photo of the district, not of Boginadi.

items.headline: Order bars Wangchuk from rallies for 60 days
items.text: A 60-day order under Section 163 bars Sonam Wangchuk from rallies in Leh during the council elections. He calls it house arrest and plans a court challenge; police say he was advised to stay home.

photo.alt: A town of low buildings and bare poplar trees in a dry valley, with snow-capped mountains behind.
photo.caption: Leh town, Ladakh, seen from above in 2015.

items.place: Jigani, Anekal taluk, Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka
items.headline: Meat sales barred near Bengaluru for PM's visit
items.text: Bengaluru Urban's deputy commissioner barred meat sales in Jigani and Kallubalu for 34 hours around the Prime Minister's 13 November visit, citing security risks. Critics called it a rights violation and sought its withdrawal.

photo.alt: A metro station entrance with a blue sign reading Biocon Hebbagodi in Kannada and English, above half-closed shutters and a steel railing.
photo.caption: Biocon Hebbagodi metro station on Bengaluru's southern edge, in the area where the clash took place.

items.headline: Court upholds payout over inmate's suicide
items.text: Tripura High Court rejected the state's challenge and ordered ₹4 lakh compensation and action against officials over a 2024 inmate suicide after discriminatory treatment. The state had cited an inquiry clearing jail staff.

photo.alt: A white two-storey building with arched windows behind a yellow iron fence, with a large mural on one wall.
photo.caption: Agartala Town Hall, in Tripura's capital, where the High Court sits, in 2012. File photo of the city.

items.place: Bani Shako, Kurmuk, Blue Nile, Sudan
items.headline: Blue Nile drone strike toll rises to 16
items.text: Kurmuk's governor says Tuesday's drone strike on displaced people at Bani Shako killed 16, up from nine, with six injured and some missing. He blames the RSF, which has not commented.

photo.alt: Rooftops and a tall beige building seen through the branches of a leafy tree under a hazy sky.
photo.caption: A street in Damazin, capital of Blue Nile state, where the wounded were taken. File photo, 2019.

items.place: Deir al-Balah and Gaza City, Gaza
items.headline: Friday strikes kill five to six in Gaza
items.text: Israeli strikes and shelling killed five to six Palestinians on Friday and injured about 20, medics said; the dead include a 14-year-old boy. No Israeli military comment on Friday's strikes was reported.

photo.alt: People in dark clothing stand among plastic-sheet tents in heavy rain on muddy ground.
photo.caption: Flooded tents of displaced Palestinians after heavy rain in Deir el-Balah, Gaza.
photo.credit: Ashraf Amra / UNRWA, via Wikimedia Commons

items.place: Area C and East Jerusalem, West Bank
items.headline: 78 West Bank structures demolished in a week
items.text: OCHA says Israeli authorities demolished, or made owners demolish, 78 Palestinian structures on 3–9 November for lacking Israeli permits, displacing 150 people, 61 of them children. It recorded 52 settler attacks.

photo.alt: Piles of stone rubble in front of sheds and water tanks on a dry hillside, with rows of houses on the slope behind.
photo.caption: Umm al-Kheir in the South Hebron Hills in 2012: the rubble of a demolished home, with the Karmel settlement behind.

items.headline: Raids blamed on ADF kill dozens in Mambasa
items.text: Raids blamed on the ADF killed at least 35 to 49 civilians in Mambasa villages on 10–12 November, local officials and media say; 14 are missing. The territory administrator says military operations are under way.

photo.alt: Men push bicycles loaded with large sacks along a red dirt road through thick forest.
photo.caption: Traders push loaded bicycles on the forest road between Epulu and Mambasa, Ituri.

items.headline: Air strike kills two students in Mrauk-U
items.text: Residents say a military air strike late on 12 November killed two university students in Mrauk-U and injured eight, including children, damaging a school and a monastery. No junta comment was reported.

photo.alt: Old stone temples and stupas among green trees and grass, with a few people and cows on a dirt path, under grey clouds.
photo.caption: Temples at Mrauk-U, Rakhine State, in 2017.

items.headline: Tear gas fired at Montreal student march
items.text: Police fired tear gas as thousands of students marched to end a week-long strike over student hardship that drew about 75,000; at least two were arrested. Ministers backed the right to mobilise but condemned vandalism.

photo.alt: A brown brick university building with the letters UQAM, next to a tall Gothic stone bell tower, at dusk.
photo.caption: UQAM's Judith-Jasmin pavilion in downtown Montreal, in 2013. File photo; students marched downtown on Friday.

items.headline: Two riot police jailed for assaulting protester
items.text: Tbilisi City Court jailed two riot police officers for five years each for assaulting protester Zviad Maisashvili at 2024 pro-EU rallies, and barred them from posts for three years. No ministry comment was reported.

photo.alt: A wide avenue lined with old pastel buildings and bare trees, with a yellow bus and cars passing.
photo.caption: Rustaveli Avenue, Tbilisi, the city's main protest route, in 2010. File photo.

focus.title: Sudan's long war
focus.dek: A drone strike on displaced people in Blue Nile killed 16, Kurmuk's governor says, up from nine; he blames the RSF, which has not commented.
focus.alt: Rooftops and a tall beige building seen through the branches of a leafy tree under a hazy sky.
